title: Lower bound on the time bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $B\in\mathbb{Q}$. If, for every natural number $K$, the sum over $0\le t<K$ of the probability that a uniformly random choice word of length $t$ leaves the run of $N$ on $x$ unhalted is at most $B$, then $1\le B$.
